code: corridor <- list(   stabilizing(1000, omega = 10),   directional(1500, delta_theta = c(0.004, 0.004, 0, 0), omega = 10) ) models <- list(   binary_b = evomod_model(binary_b(loci = 50, traits = 4),                           binary_b_mutation(rate = 0.001, sd = 0.2, rate_b = 0.0005),                           env_sd = 0.8, init_sd = 0.2),   additive = evomod_model(additive(loci = 50, traits = 4),                           mutation(rate = 0.001, cov = 0.2),                           env_sd = 0.8, init_sd = 0.2) ) pops <- lapply(models, evolve, regimes = corridor, n = 500, record_every = 50, seed = 1) module_trace <- function(pop, name) {   G <- g_matrices(pop)   do.call(rbind, lapply(names(G), function(gen) {     a <- avg_corr(G[[gen]], modules = list(1:2, 3:4))     data.frame(architecture = name, generation = as.integer(gen),                within_1 = a$within[1], within_2 = a$within[2], between = a$between)   })) } trace <- do.call(rbind, Map(module_trace, pops, names(pops)))  op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1)) for (arch in names(pops)) {   d <- trace[trace$architecture == arch, ]   matplot(d$generation, d[, c("within_1", "within_2", "between")], type = "l", lty = 1,           col = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "grey50"), ylim = c(-0.2, 0.6),           xlab = "Generation", ylab = "Average genetic correlation", main = arch)   abline(v = 1000, col = "grey85") } legend("topleft", c("within module 1", "within module 2", "between"),        col = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "grey50"), lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.8) par(op)

code: self_epistasis <- function(e) {   E <- array(0, c(2, 2, 2))   E[1, 1, 1] <- e   E } epistasis <- c(negative = -0.05, none = 0, positive = 0.05) selection <- list(stabilizing(1000, omega = 20),                   directional(2000, delta_theta = c(0.005, 0), omega = 20)) G11 <- sapply(epistasis, function(e) {   arch <- if (e == 0) additive(50, 2) else multilinear(50, 2, self_epistasis(e))   m <- evomod_model(arch, mutation(rate = 0.005, cov = 0.05), env_sd = 1)   pop <- evolve(m, selection, n = 500, record_every = 50, seed = 2)   v <- variances(pop)   v$G[v$trait == "trait1"] }) gens <- seq(0, 3000, by = 50)   # recorded generations matplot(gens, G11, type = "l", lty = 1, col = c("#0072B2", "grey40", "#D55E00"),         xlab = "Generation", ylab = "Additive variance, trait 1") abline(v = 1000, col = "grey85") legend("topleft", names(epistasis), col = c("#0072B2", "grey40", "#D55E00"), lty = 1, bty = "n") m <- evomod_model(multilinear(50, 2, self_epistasis(0.05)),                   mutation(rate = 0.005, cov = 0.05), env_sd = 1) pop <- evolve(m, selection, n = 500, record_every = 500, seed = 2) L <- local_effects(pop, individual = 1) Y <- local_effects(evomod_model(additive(50, 2), mutation(0.1, 0.1)),                    alleles = genomes(pop)[, , 1])   # reference (additive) effects plot(Y[1, ], L[1, ], xlab = "Reference effect, trait 1", ylab = "Local effect, trait 1") abline(0, 1, col = "grey60")

title: Getting started with evomod2
text: Fitness Gaussian around optimum \(\theta\) (theta), covariance \(\Omega\) (omega; larger \(\Omega\) means weaker selection): \[w(z) = \exp\left(-\tfrac{1}{2} (z - \theta)^\top \Omega^{-1} (z - \theta)\right)\] directional() moves optimum delta_theta every generation; traits 1 2 pushed traits 3 4 stay put. fluctuating() makes optimum jump every generations, traits together, independently, blocks (O & Whitlock 2023):
code: omega <- diag(10, 4) regimes <- list(   drift(100),                                                  # no selection   stabilizing(300, omega = omega),                             # fixed optimum   directional(300, delta_theta = c(0.02, 0.02, 0, 0), omega = omega)  # moving optimum ) fluctuating(5000, every = 10, step = 0.2, omega = 1, structure = list(1:2, 3:4)) #> <evomod regime> fluctuating for 5000 generations

title: evomod2: evolution of genetic architecture in multivariate traits
text: Genomes: allele carries effect vector trait space; effect locus, \(Y_l\), sum two alleles. Effects measured reference genotype (effects zero), new populations start unless init_sd > 0. additive(): \(x = \sum_l Y_l\). multilinear(): \(x = S + \sum_{<j} \varepsilon(Y_i, Y_j)\) \(S = \sum_l Y_l\) traits × traits × traits tensor \(\varepsilon\) shared pairs loci (Hansen & Wagner 2001; random_epsilon()), different tensor every pair loci (Jones, Bürger & Arnold 2014; pairwise_epsilon()). contribution_matrix(): model O & Whitlock (2023), \(x = C \) weight genes \(\) contribution genes \(C\) separate loci, used contribution_mutation(). binary_b(): model Melo & Marroig (2015). allele scalar effect \(y\) column binary matrix \(B\) saying traits affects, \(x = B y\). Used binary_b_mutation(), mutates \(y\) entries \(B\) separately (b_mutation = "random" reproduces B mutation published simulations, changed entries half nominal rate). Phenotypes: \(z = x + e\), \(e \sim N(0, \sigma_e^2 )\) \(\sigma_e\) = env_sd. Life cycle: discrete generations (wright_fisher(), default) overlapping generations (moran(): generation \(n\) birth-death events, replacing random individual offspring two parents drawn proportion fitness), life cycle Jones et al. (viability_selection(): separate sexes, females mating several males, viability selection zygotes); evomod_model(..., life_cycle = moran()). Mutation: allele mutates probability rate per generation (mutation() adds multivariate normal vector covariance cov; binary_b_mutation() contribution_mutation() rates kind gene). mutation replaces allele’s effect \(e\) \(\rho\, e + \delta\), \(\rho\) = persistence \(\delta\) fresh draw; persistence = 1 (default) random walk, 0 house cards model (hoc_mutation()), every architecture. Recombination: loci unlinked default. genetic_map(chromosomes, length) places loci evenly along chromosomes (Haldane map function), linkage(rates) sets recombination fraction pair neighbouring loci; pass either evomod_model(..., recombination = ). Regimes: drift(), stabilizing(), directional() (optimum moves steadily) fluctuating() (optimum jumps every generations, traits together, independently, blocks; O & Whitlock 2023). generation: optimum moves (directional fluctuating regimes), fitness \(w = \exp(-\tfrac{1}{2} (z - \theta)^\top \Omega^{-1} (z - \theta))\) computed, life cycle produces next generation: wright_fisher(), every individual mutates \(n\) offspring produced parents drawn probability proportional fitness; moran(), \(n\) birth-death events; viability_selection(), matings, zygotes surviving probability \(w\), regulation back \(n\). Offspring inherit alleles model’s recombination. Random numbers come R’s generator: set.seed() seed makes runs reproducible, continuing population gives result single run.
